verses.text_en: And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, †and wind†.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema jugu, do krajeva zemlje. Ondje vidjeh troja otvorena nebeska vrata; iz njih dolaze rosa, kiša †i vjetar†.

verses.text_en: And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema istoku, do krajeva neba. Ondje vidjeh otvorena troja istočna nebeska vrata, a iznad njih mala vrata.

verses.text_en: Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.
verses.text_hr: Kroz svaka od tih malih vrata prolaze nebeske zvijezde i kreću se svojom putanjom prema zapadu, putem koji im je pokazan.

verses.text_en: And as often as I saw I blessed always the Lord of Glory, and I continued to bless the Lord of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to =spirits= and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.
verses.text_hr: Kad god bih to vidio, uvijek sam blagoslivljao Gospodina Slave. Neprestano sam blagoslivljao Gospodina Slave koji je učinio velika i slavna čudesa da bi veličinu svojega djela pokazao anđelima, =duhovima= i ljudima, kako bi hvalili Njegovo djelo i sve Njegovo stvorenje; da vide djelo Njegove moći, hvale veliko djelo Njegovih ruku i blagoslivljaju Ga dovijeka.
